activity.notes: Wahunsenacawh, commonly called Powhatan, was the paramount chief of Tsenacommacah, the Powhatan political confederacy encountered by the Jamestown settlers. His accession date is not securely fixed, so the start is approximate; his death in 1618 ends the Activity.
